name: Deep Underground Neutrino Experiment (DUNE), Far Detector Technical Design Report, Volume IV: Far Detector Single-phase Technology

summary.plain: The engineering detail of the first far-detector module: a single-phase liquid-argon time projection chamber.
summary.technical: DUNE FD TDR Vol. IV (arXiv:2002.03010, Feb 2020): design of the single-phase LArTPC technology used in FD1-HD, including anode/cathode plane assemblies, field cage, HV and readout electronics.
